page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top right. Below: a sequence of epigram headings, each followed by a verse stanza (two lines in roman with an italic or second-hand pairing). Single column, full width throughout. No margin notes.

main_text.head: HELENA.
main_text.p:
Vix fieri, si sint gignentum in femine vires,
Non, Iouis & Ledæ filia, pulcra potes.
Vix fieri, si sint gignentum in femine vires,
Et Iouis & Ledæ filia casta potes.
main_text.head: EADEM.
main_text.p:
Mille petita procis, totidem repetita carinis,
Mille poetarum fama, laborque fui.
O si nota minus, minus & formosa fuissem,
Maxima matrona est laus latuisse proba.
main_text.head: PENELOPE.
main_text.p:
Formosam, viduam, ditemq́, in flore iuuentæ
Inter tot iuuenes Penelopea procos,
Quite seruatam bis denos credidit annos,
Non oculis tantum captus, opinor, erat.
main_text.head: DIDO.
main_text.p:
Asta, decens, generosa animi, Phœnissa peregi
Fœmina, magnanimis vix imitanda viris.
At tu sacratam, Maro, labe adspergere famam,
Conaris, fama non sine labe tua.
main_text.head: SOPHONISBA.
main_text.p:
Viuere post vitā patriam, patremq́, domumq́,
Non potero dominis mancipium Ausonis.
Morte manu mittar, poteram fœlicius ante,
Non iterum tadis conciliata nouis.
main_text.head: ALEXANDER MACEDO.
main_text.p:
Ama dira fames, sitis & vesana cruoris
Rex Macedo vitæ carnificina tuæ;
